state.purpose: Fresh independent source review of worker recovery contracts. Application delegates and pluggable subscription cleanup can fail. These questions ask observable control flow. A positive model answer is advisory; deterministic reproductions and documented contracts decide findings. Other retries may be intentionally at least once.

cursor_extractor_failure_skips_event.instructions: If directory.Apply throws from its supplied tenant extractor, does this cursor retain a position after the failed event for its next enumeration?

cursor_dispose_fault_retains_reading.instructions: If subscription.DisposeAsync throws in Cursor.ReadAsync cleanup, does _reading remain set so a later enumeration is rejected?

coordinator_cancel_fault_bypasses_join.instructions: When a cancellation callback throws during ReleaseAsync, can coordination finish before the removed workload Run task completes?

combined_workers_terminal_fault_hidden.instructions: If one RetryAsync listener escapes with an unrecoverable failure while another healthy listener remains pending, does ExecuteAsync stay pending instead of reporting that failure?
